title: The Sacramental Prayer
summary: An elder or priest administers the sacrament; the church kneels and prays to the Father in the name of Christ, asking that the bread be blessed and sanctified.

explicit_facts.text: An elder or priest administers the flesh and blood of Christ to the church according to Christ’s commandments.
The church kneels with the elder or priest, who prays to the Father in the name of Christ.
The prayer asks God to bless and sanctify the bread for those who partake.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The elder or priest is visible administering bread to the assembled church.
Members of the church kneel during the prayer.
unspecified_visual_details: The church's identity, size, and composition.
The architecture, furnishings, clothing, and appearance of the people.

spoken_dialogue.text: O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this bread to the souls of all those who partake of it;
spoken_dialogue.speaker: An elder or priest

narration.text: And they did kneel down with the church, and pray to the Father in the name of Christ, saying:

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The prayer identifies the bread as a remembrance of the body of Christ and asks that those who partake always have his Spirit with them.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Christ or the Father as visibly present.
